title: Catalog read robustness and write amplification (lab single-classifier C4)
description: Typed cause for PayloadUnavailable/JournalUnavailable plus one transient S3 GET retry; find and stop the whole-snapshot rewrite storm (8,550 blobs / 11.19 GB since 2026-10-21T01Z, 1,000-2,172 commits/hour). Acceptance: transient-error retry spec; typed cause for permanent failure; measured commit-rate baseline before/after. Never retry writes or conditional puts.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Diagnosis (read-only, 2026-10-22T01:5xZ). Commits are made by the SQS worker command loop (cyclotron-console-worker, ~50 invocations/h), one per publication job, not by BFF reads. Per job: 3 catalog commits (enqueue, claim, finish) + a lease acquire AND release on the workspace journal and on each of 3 runtime journals (8 commits, each rewriting a ~3.2 MB snapshot) + per-event commits. A new item adds ~13 runtime commits per runtime (every append_event is its own commit). Head revisions: catalog 1202, 3 runtimes 1914 each, shared-batches 352, publication workspace 1326 = 8,622 blobs. 106 distinct items produced 356 jobs (3 publications x repeats). Plan: coalesce runtime event appends into the next durable barrier (cache_owned only), typed cause + one GET retry.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented in worktree Cyclotron-c4 (branch fix/catalog-write-amplification): s3_transient.py (one retry on transient GET, class-name-only cause), PayloadUnavailable/JournalUnavailable.cause + warning log, S3RuntimeStores event coalescing for owning handles. Spec benchmark: 1 new item + 2 replays x 3 classifiers = 48 -> 24 runtime commits, 9.5 -> 4.8 MB. Remaining amplification (lease acquire/release per job, 4 MiB journal budget at 3.2 MB) recorded as follow-ups. make check running.
